summary: Frontend-only test of the PR #7 study-journey expansion, run with Playwright on the public URL at 390x844 and 360x640 in light and dark mode. Static checks pass: node --test tests/study-journey-expansion.test.mjs passes 3/3 and tsc --noEmit is clean. REVELATION: /world/revelation is playable. The campaign map shows 13 station nodes (rev-intro..rev-creation) and the header reads 'x / 13 Stationen'. rev-intro, rev-creation and rev-throne were played end to end: the ELB 1905 readings render, mc, tf and free tasks plus the exam can be answered, the result is 'Station abgeschlossen! 2 von 2', +60 EP, and progress shows 1/13 (8%) after reload. Historical mode lists Patmos and all seven churches (Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamon, Thyatira, Sardes, Philadelphia, Laodizea). HISTORY: the chips history-1 (Josua & Richter) and history-tribes (3) both appear and switching works. history-tribes-family completes and shows 1/3 (33%). PSALMS: psalms-5 (4) and psalms-6 (2) chips appear. station-illustration-img renders on all 6 new psalms stations with the correct aspect ratio (1000x747 in a 342x255 box; 900x900 in a 342x342 box). psalms-6-love completes. GOSPELS: the chips are synoptics (syn-1, syn-2, synoptics-exam) plus a new 'synoptic' chip (2 stations), with no duplicate method station. synoptic-ministry completes and reuses the syn-1/syn-2 images. LETTERS: letters-more (7) appears and letters-more-philemon completes. In letters-14 the readings are Jud 1,3-4 / 1,5-16 / 1,17-25, the text shows, and the reader opens /bible?b=Jud&ch=1&v=3 with text. PROPHETS: only the prophets and prophets-2 chips appear, as intended. STUDY VIEW: on the home Studienreise tab the cards show updated counts (history 14, psalms 50, gospels 33, letters 22, revelation 13). /world/<id>?view=study lists every new station (revelation 13, history +3, psalms +6, gospels +2, letters +7), and tapping study-station-rev-throne opens /station/rev-throne. ALL 31 new stations: the study phase renders ELB text with reader links and has no horizontal overflow. PROGRESS PRESERVATION: completed records for kp-1, john-1, john-2, gb1-1, letters-14, ps1-1 and syn-1, plus xp 420 and phase {kp-2:2}, were injected into biblia_state. After reload all of them are intact and the world headers and chips show them (prophets-2 13%, john 20%, history-1 9%, letters 7%, psalms-1 9%, synoptics 33%, kp-1 'Abgeschlossen'). git diff shows only the Jude readings changed in letters.json, so existing IDs are unchanged. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages.

ui_bugs.component: CampaignMap (short new campaigns: psalms-5, psalms-6, synoptic, history-tribes)
ui_bugs.issue: Initial view at 390x844: the stations in the right column (x=680) are cut off at the right edge or sit under the right-side map controls (zoom, recenter, fullscreen), e.g. psalms-5 stations 2 and 4, and synoptic-passion is off-screen. Existing campaigns (psalms-4, synoptics) fit cleanly. The new JSON uses a fixed 320/680 zig-zag and a small mapH (700-1160) instead of the buildCampaign layout (psalmsKit.ts:64-65, x = 500 ± 290·sin, mapH = n·240+320).

design_issues.screen: Campaign maps of all 6 new campaigns
issues: No trail or path lines between stations, and no progression. Every new station has requires: [], and CampaignMap draws edges only from requires (CampaignMap.tsx:23, 202). Existing campaigns show dotted trails and sequential unlocking (see psalms-4), so the new maps look different from the current design. Either add a sequential requires chain (safe: no user has progress on the new IDs) or draw trails by station order.
rev-seals uses icon 'lock'. On the map it looks like the grey lock that marks locked stations in other campaigns, so users may think it is locked. Use a different icon (e.g. 'key' or 'book').

The goal text is a template with the title pasted in, which is ungrammatical: 'Du kannst Der Thronsaal und das Lamm anhand der angegebenen Schriftstellen erklären und Textaussage von Auslegung unterscheiden' (capitalised article, wrong case, missing plural or article). This affects rev-intro..rev-creation.
psalms-6-poetry and psalms-6-love both reuse the same image 'way-liebe-partnerschaft' (LOW, acceptable under the no-new-images rule).

'Synoptischer Vergleich' (synoptics) and 'Die Evangelien im Vergleich: Wirken und Passion' (synoptic) sit side by side with near-identical names. Also, the gospels world 'planned' list in worlds.ts was not updated to mention the new campaign (LOW).

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix the layout of the new campaign maps so all nodes fit the initial view and stay clear of the right-side controls. Reuse the psalmsKit pos() / mapH formula, or regenerate x/y/mapH for psalms-5, psalms-6, synoptic, history-tribes, letters-more and revelation.

MEDIUM (design parity): The new campaigns have no trail lines or sequential unlocking because requires is [] everywhere. Add requires chains, or make CampaignMap draw edges by order, to keep the current design.
LOW: Change the rev-seals icon from 'lock' to something that cannot be mistaken for the locked state.
LOW (editorial): Fix the templated Lernziel grammar in the 13 revelation stations ('Du kannst Der Thronsaal…').

LOW (data, pre-existing): backend/data/elb1905.json contains 6 stray source markers '(G<ch>:<v>)'. One shows in the new station letters-more-3john (3Joh 1,14: '…mündlich miteinander reden. (G1:15) Friede dir…'). Strip them or render them as verse 15.
critical_code_review_comments: john.ts: the 6 new JSON campaigns are added to IMPORTED with no ID collisions. worlds.ts campaignIds match, and prophets-more is correctly left out.
TaskView: mc options are shuffled but the testIDs keep the original index, so answer keys line up. The mc answer positions in the new data are spread out (0:20, 1:22, 2:20) and tf is 31/31.
Only one field changed in letters.json (the letters-14 readings). No existing station ID or progress key was renamed. migrate() keeps the stations record as it is.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows work; 1 medium layout issue + design-parity gaps)

seed_data_creation: None. Only the test browser's localStorage (biblia_state) was changed, with injected progress for the persistence check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run is a fresh context. To simulate an existing user, set localStorage 'biblia_state' to JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(state)) (double-encoded), then reload. After the first launch, every page.goto shows a ~1s logo intro, so wait about 2.3s before tapping. TF tasks auto-check (no -check button); mc tasks need {prefix}-check; free tasks need a fill, then -show-model, then -self-*. Station testIDs: task-*/exam-* prefixes, station-next-button, phase-*. Use emulate_media(color_scheme='dark') for dark mode.
